channel.label: Channel
channel.description: The channel where the counting happens. Messages already in a new channel are left alone.

lives.label: Lives
lives.description: How many wrong numbers a run survives. Each costs a life, and losing the last one resets the count to 0. With unlimited lives, wrong numbers are only removed.

regenerateLives.label: Regenerate Lives
regenerateLives.description: Give back a life, up to the maximum, when a milestone is counted, like 100, 250, 500 or 1000. Only with limited lives.

allowMath.label: Math
allowMath.description: Allow numbers to be sent as math, like `1+1`, `2*3`, `2^3` or `3!`.

milestoneReactions.label: Milestone Reactions
milestoneReactions.description: React with 🎉 when a milestone is counted, like 100, 250, 500 or 1000.
